speaker: LICH
description: An ancient, genderless undead spellcaster with a dry, hollow timbre that resonates with faint magical undertones. Speaks in a neutral, archaic dialect at a slow, deliberate pace, each word weighted with cold authority. Emotional baseline is detached menace — calculating, powerful, and strategic — revealing no warmth or hesitation. Delivery should be measured and precise, with minimal inflection but an underlying threat that commands absolute attention; pauses are used as weapons to unsettle listeners.
ref_text: “He is alive enough for your purposes, and this way he’ll struggle less. And you should watch your tone, little whelp – you’re not in charge here and I could kill you whenever I want without anyone batting an eye. Enough of your ‘information’ has turned out to be incorrect that your value is being questioned.”
